description: Two disclosures and the trailing '~' omitted. RFC 9901 §4: "In the case that there is no Key Binding JWT, the last element MUST be an empty string and the last separating tilde character MUST NOT be omitted". Measured 2026-11-18 on v1.8.0: the last disclosure read as the KB-JWT (gone from the resolved claims), the artifact an error only as "kb-jwt must have 3 dot-separated segments". 1.8.1 (SPEC §6 step 2): that artifact's error, sd_jwt_final_component_not_kb_jwt, before anything is resolved.
